title: Listening Drill — Parcel collection
description: Customer service dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Parcel collection
sections.transcript:
CUSTOMER: I need some help with a parcel I collected. The main problem is a torn label. I thought I could solve it myself, but the instructions don't cover what I've seen.

ADVISER: We can look into it. First please send the tracking number. Then bring the item to the parcel counter. If you go to the original collection point they will send you back here.

CUSTOMER: What happens if you can't sort it out while I'm there?

ADVISER: Ask for a written receipt. don't discard the original packaging. Keep the confirmation until the issue has been closed.
